assets.prompt:
Generate ONE original functional UI icon for LinguaLoop's Warm Paper and Ink design family, NOT an interface mockup.
Style: clean refined literary fine-ink line drawing; dark walnut #3F382F, with at most a tiny muted sage #78816B accent. Elegant restrained adult stationery feeling. Slightly human rounded pen joins but balanced precise geometry. NO crosshatching, paper grain, watercolors, shadows, letters, text, labels, sticker border, frame, gloss or gradients. NO purple. Clear simple silhouette readable at 24px, approximately 1.7px stroke when displayed at 24px. Single object centered, occupies about 70% of square canvas, generous equal transparent margins. Truly transparent alpha background, including interior spaces; do not draw any paper backdrop or checkerboard. Output a square PNG master. All lines and optical weight should feel from one consistent icon family.
